question: How should we split the chores in the flat?

parties.label: Dev
parties.text: Chores should be split by time, because cleaning the bathroom takes far longer than taking out the bins.

parties.label: Maya
parties.text: We should just alternate weeks. Keeping a time log for chores will create more arguments, not fewer.

parties.label: Leo
parties.text: I work nights so I can't do anything noisy in the mornings. I'm happy to do more of the quiet tasks.
